name: website-himasri
description: Website Resmi HIMASRI — Himpunan Mahasiswa Sriwijaya, Institut Teknologi PLN

scripts.build: npm --workspace=web run build && npm --workspace=functions run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=web run lint && npm --workspace=functions run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore,storage,functions
